It is my understanding that Hadley and Co. are working on features currently and speed will come later. Therefore there are two ways to speed up the graphing process: 1) buy the fastest computer you can afford or 2) give Hadley a grant for a student or postdoc to work on speed. 

Otherwise... get a tea/coffee while it's doing it's thing. You could probably use a break from your computer anyway. Rest your eyes and whatnot.
